issues.title: WIN-049: quantitative claim 1.48% at equator lacks geometric definition
issues.description: WIN-049 detail_evidence states tidal force drops to 1.48% at the equator but this lacks geometric definition of what equatorial offset means in the dome model and does not reproduce under the Newtonian 1/r^3 falloff law cited in the sibling WIN-050. The claim is used to argue declination forcing is concentrated near sub-lunar point.
issues.routing_reason: Moderate hole requiring geometry verification: either define what at-equator means geometrically in dome model (~10,000 km from sub-lunar point) OR replace 1.48% with a properly-derived value (0.2% at disc edge 20,015 km per curmudgeon recommendation). Requires checking the 1/r^3 math.
